name: job-card
title: Job card
description: A job opening as one card: company, title, a labelled list of place, mode, contract and pay, skill tags, how fresh it is, and a save toggle.
docs: title is the one link of the card (href, or onOpen for a button; a screen reader also hears at {company}) and the whole card opens it. location, workMode (onsite, hybrid or remote) and type are facts in a definition list with a glyph each, and salary is { min?, max?, currency, period? } formatted with Intl in the locale you name: 85000 to 105000 EUR per year reads €85K – €105K / year (a range is written in one style: from 10,000 up both ends are short, 9500 to 12500 reads €9.5K – €12.5K), with a minimum only From €85K, with a maximum only Up to €105K, and with no salary there is no pay row at all. postedAt is written in words (Posted 2 days ago) with the exact date in a tooltip a tap opens too, and a posting under three days old gets New in words; pass now to pin the clock for server HTML and tests, otherwise the card reads the browser clock after the first paint. The save button is a toggle with aria-pressed whose name says which job it saves (Save Senior Product Designer at Halcyon Freight); saved controls it (or defaultSaved lets the card keep it), onSave(next) reports it, and it is a separate target above the card's link. labels carries every word.
